hypothesis: The causal near-minus-far ATM implied-vol term slope (term_slope) has a positive monotone (Spearman rank) relationship with subsequent forward return-tail asymmetry of the same underlying, independent of any trading wrapper; tested on real on-disk captures at the composed EVAL-74 term floor.
extends: EVAL-74 (same term_slope signal and sealed term floor) + EVAL-85 (same forward return-tail-asymmetry target); distinct cell: term slope -> forward tail asymmetry

protocol.title: Options implied-vol term slope (near-minus-far ATM IV) -> forward return-tail asymmetry predictiveness (Spearman rank IC)
protocol.extends: EVAL-74 (same term_slope signal and sealed term floor) + EVAL-85 (same forward return-tail-asymmetry target); distinct cell: term slope -> forward tail asymmetry
protocol.supersedes: nothing -- complements EVAL-74/84/85/87/96/98; no traded-form claim
protocol.signal: causal per-bar near-minus-far ATM IV term slope (EVAL-74 _term_bars: IV(near expiry) - IV(far expiry) in vol points), forward-filled and expanding-zscored end-of-bar k (reused e71._forward_fill/e61.expanding_zscore)
protocol.target_detail: forward return-tail asymmetry = (q95 - median) - (median - q05) over the SAME underlying's next H perp log returns (strictly after the decision at bar k), reused e85._forward_return_tail_asym verbatim
protocol.statistic: Spearman rank correlation IC = rho(signal_z_k, tail_asym_k); directional permutation H1: IC>0 (steeper near-minus-far IV slope -> more positively asymmetric forward return tails)
protocol.go_bar: GO only if, on BOTH BTC and ETH and at least one config, Spearman IC > 0, directional permutation p < 0.05, block-bootstrap 95% CI lower > 0, and pooled BH-FDR rejects that config; else NO-GO CONFIRMED (PASS).
